mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS agentId, a.nickname AS agentName, a.nickname AS agentNickName, IFNULL(conv.total_count, 0) AS totalCount, IFNULL(conv.effective_count, 0) AS effectiveCount, IFNULL(conv.total_duration, 0) AS totalDuration, IFNULL(online.online_duration, 0) AS onlineDuration FROM cs_agent a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN agent_message_count > 0 AND visitor_message_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective_count, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time, COALESCE(end_time, NOW()))) AS total_duration FROM cs_conversation WHERE deleted = 0 AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY agent_id ) conv ON a.id = conv.agent_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, SUM( TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(start_time, #{startDate}), LEAST(COALESCE(end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')) ) ) AS online_duration FROM cs_agent_status_log WHERE status IN (1, 2) AND start_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= #{startDate}) GROUP BY agent_id ) online ON a.id = online.agent_id WHERE (conv.total_count > 0 OR online.online_duration > 0) ORDER BY conv.total_count DESC

SELECT CONCAT(IFNULL(user_province, '未知'), ' ', IFNULL(user_city, '')) AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS visitorCount FROM cs_conversation WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY user_province, user_city ORDER BY visitorCount DESC

SELECT a.id AS agentId, a.nickname AS agentName, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sl.status IN (1, 2) THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(sl.start_time, CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 00:00:00')), LEAST(COALESCE(sl.end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 23:59:59')) ) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS onlineDuration, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sl.status = 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(sl.start_time, CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 00:00:00')), LEAST(COALESCE(sl.end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 23:59:59')) ) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS offlineDuration, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sl.status = 3 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(sl.start_time, CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 00:00:00')), LEAST(COALESCE(sl.end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 23:59:59')) ) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS invisibleDuration, MIN(CASE WHEN sl.status IN (1, 2) THEN sl.start_time END) AS earliestLogin, MAX(CASE WHEN sl.status = 0 THEN sl.start_time END) AS latestLogout FROM cs_agent a INNER JOIN cs_agent_status_log sl ON a.id = sl.agent_id WHERE sl.start_time <= CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND (sl.end_time IS NULL OR sl.end_time >= CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 00:00:00')) GROUP BY a.id, a.nickname ORDER BY a.nickname

SELECT CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2) THEN '在线' WHEN status = 3 THEN '隐身' ELSE '离线' END AS statusText, GREATEST(start_time, CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 00:00:00')) AS startTime, LEAST(COALESCE(end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 23:59:59')) AS endTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(start_time, CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 00:00:00')), LEAST(COALESCE(end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 23:59:59')) ) AS durationSeconds FROM cs_agent_status_log WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND start_time <= CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= CONCAT(#{queryDate}, ' 00:00:00')) ORDER BY start_time ASC

SELECT a.id AS agentId, a.nickname AS agentName, IFNULL(conv.effective_count, 0) AS effectiveCount, IFNULL(conv.no_response_count, 0) AS noResponseCount, IFNULL(conv.total_count, 0) AS totalCount, IFNULL(invisible.invisible_duration, 0) AS invisibleDuration, IFNULL(offline.offline_duration, 0) AS offlineDuration, CASE WHEN IFNULL(conv.total_visitor_msg, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(IFNULL(conv.timely_count, 0) * 100.0 / conv.total_visitor_msg, 2) END AS timelyReplyRate FROM cs_agent a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN agent_message_count > 0 AND visitor_message_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 AND agent_message_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_response_count, SUM(IFNULL(timely_reply_count, 0)) AS timely_count, SUM(IFNULL(visitor_message_count, 0)) AS total_visitor_msg FROM cs_conversation WHERE deleted = 0 AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY agent_id ) conv ON a.id = conv.agent_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(start_time, #{startDate}), LEAST(COALESCE(end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')) )) AS invisible_duration FROM cs_agent_status_log WHERE status = 3 AND start_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= #{startDate}) GROUP BY agent_id ) invisible ON a.id = invisible.agent_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(start_time, #{startDate}), LEAST(COALESCE(end_time, NOW()), CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')) )) AS offline_duration FROM cs_agent_status_log WHERE status = 0 AND start_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= #{startDate}) GROUP BY agent_id ) offline ON a.id = offline.agent_id WHERE (conv.total_count > 0 OR invisible.invisible_duration > 0 OR offline.offline_duration > 0) ORDER BY conv.total_count DESC
